Safe mode

Loads WordPress with only Stonewright and a default theme. The link works once.

What Rescue does. After each risky change Stonewright makes, it checks that the site still loads and, when it does not, restores the changed item to the state recorded just before.

What it never does. It never touches anything Stonewright did not change, and it cannot repair WordPress core, wp-config.php or a database that is down.

Rescue helper
Not installed

Safe mode is not available, and a fatal error after a change is not recorded automatically, because the rescue helper is not in place. Stonewright installs it when it is activated and repairs it on a wp-admin page load.

Needs attention (5)

Not verified means no health check has reported on the change yet. It does not mean the site is broken. Check again, or roll the change back.

Recent changes only Rescue keeps

History has no record of these changes, or cannot undo them, so they stay here. A change that passed its health check can still be rolled back. The journal keeps the last 50 changes.
